units.source_text: 我等待着，什么都不想干。

en.t: I waited, unwilling to do anything.

units.source_text: 我气喘吁吁地跑过来，在山毛榉树下休想，以后想干什么，自己也不知道。

en.t: I had run over breathlessly and tried to rest under the beech tree, without even knowing myself what I wanted to do afterward.

units.source_text: 我一直过着与外界无缘的生活，一旦投身外界，就产生一种幻想，仿佛一切都变得容易，都成为可能了。

en.t: I had always lived a life cut off from the outside world, and once I threw myself into it, I was seized by the illusion that everything had become easy and everything was possible.
